name: Direct URL to an Access Management page is denied without exposing records: role-management
description:
Objective: Direct URL to an Access Management page is denied without exposing records: role-management.
Preconditions: Open Role enforcement with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Role enforcement.
2. Direct URL to an Access Management page is denied without exposing records: role-management.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
